plaintext.source: No decipherment on the leaves; the contributor found none in print.

transcription.source: the contributor's transcription from the ASF MAP images (1272 px), made twice by AI agents (the second blind, frozen and hashed before reconciling), reviewed by a second model on 70 spot checks; the project compared line 4 of doc. 112 c. 256r with the image (about 45 signs agree)
transcription.notes: One letter; 91 cipher units, 371 signs (the contributor's provisional word count); cipher from c. 220v line 6 to c. 221v.

system.summary: Homophonic sign alphabet with up to three signs a letter, word signs (et, che, per, io, tu, voi, noi, quando, come, titles), nulls and numbers from 10 for names, per the key sheet MAP LXXII 183; six signs for doubled consonants and a sign for non are not on the sheet.
system.notes: The sheet gives the sign with the dotted dash for both n and c; Ridolfi writes d and l alike.

prior_solution.where: None found by the contributor for docs. 112, 113, 115 and 96; Desjardins (1859) prints the glossed doc. 114 only. Not re-searched by the project.

conditions.human_role: Contributed result (GitHub issue #589, Andrew Aymeloglu): AI agents matched the glossed word pairs of Ridolfi 107 and 110 to the key sheets of filza LXXII, transcribed the letters twice and read them; a second model reviewed; the contributor reviewed the result. The project checked and filed it.

solution.what: Andrew Aymeloglu (issue #589): the glossed word pairs of Ridolfi's letters MAP LXXIV 107 and 110 compared with the key sheets of filza LXXII; LXXII 183 reproduces them (44 of 44 letters on eight words, his figure; not held out).

The four letters transcribed twice from the 1272 px images by AI agents, the second pass blind and frozen before reconciling; alternatives recorded for every ambiguous sign (the contributor's record).

The sheet applied to Ridolfi 112, 113, 115 and Alamanni 96; six signs for doubled consonants and non added from glosses and from the words they make. Words graded strict, forced, lenient, doubtful, unread: Ridolfi 104, 90, 85, 2, 2 of 283; Alamanni 37, 24, 19, 0, 11 of 91.

The contributor's calibration: with the gloss of Ridolfi 107 c. 241v masked, the reader got 28 of 38 glossed words right (74%), 4 confidently wrong. His key-shuffle control: z = 18.5 (Ridolfi), 13.5 (Alamanni). Not repeated by the project.

Brice Dudout (comment on issue #589; his report, no files sent): the published key.json applied unchanged to the glossed Ridolfi letter MAP LXXIV doc. 114 (865 signs, his own frozen transcription) against Desjardins's printed text: character agreement 0.774 against 0.397 for the best of 200 shuffled keys; his bar was 0.85, so the test failed by his own rule; 101 of 175 words exact.

Integration check: aaymeloglu/own_decode.py, written from key.json and the transcriptions, gives the key output of reading.txt for all 283 and 91 cipher words and the contributor's tier counts. The key sheet (image 79536) and Ridolfi 112 c. 256r (image 81807) fetched from the ASF server: SHA-256 as in images.tsv; the sheet's alphabet is as key.json gives it; line 4 of c. 256r agrees with the transcription (about 45 signs). Other leaves not compared. Read share by the README rule set to the strict tier (36.7% and 40.7%).

outcome.method: read after matching with key from external sources
outcome.method_basis: The key sheet MAP LXXII 183, filed in the same fonds, was matched to Ridolfi's glossed letters by the contributor and applied to four bare letters; the project re-ran the lookup with its own decoder.
outcome.fraction_read_source: aaymeloglu/own_decode.py: cipher words with no ambiguous sign (the contributor's strict tier), 104 of 283 (Ridolfi) and 37 of 91 (Alamanni) = 141 of 374; with the forced words 255 of 374 (68.2%); the contributor's widest figure, every word with a proposed reading, is 98.6% and 87.9%.
outcome.notes: Reading and key work by Andrew Aymeloglu with AI agents; the project re-ran the lookup and compared two images. The connected text is a proposal: about a third of the words are free of a choice between sign values.

texts.label: Ridolfi to Piero de' Medici, Milan, 16, 21 and 30 October 1494
texts.summary: Ridolfi reports from Milan as Charles VIII comes through Lombardy: the King received at Pavia castle by the Duchess Bona; the Pavia citizens' protest against the milling duty; on the day the death of Gian Galeazzo was announced, the King's night visit to Bona and Duchess Isabella's refusal to appear; opinion in Milan that Florence cannot resist the French.
texts.note: Reader's note (the project, 14 Nov 2026), not a review grade: Read the Italian and the English of the three letters as sentences: they hold together and fit the dated events. But only 104 of 283 cipher words are free of a choice between sign values, 85 were chosen by sense, and the contributor's own blind calibration got 74% of glossed words right; A connected proposal with a small secure part.

texts.label: Alamanni to Piero de' Medici, Vigevano, 26 April 1494
texts.summary: Alamanni privately urges Piero de' Medici that the King of Naples's plan to turn Genoa is the one remedy, must not be delayed and must be entered only with enough preparation, that name 22 will never trust the King, and that Piero must tell no one; on the last leaf, Lodovico's three threats, the second unread.
texts.note: Reader's note (the project, 14 Nov 2026), not a review grade: Read the Italian and the English as sentences: the cipher passages fit the clear text around them, with 11 of 91 cipher words unread and 19 chosen by sense; 37 words are free of a choice between sign values.
